newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon starts savings and loans.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon starts savings and loans.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Jeffrey Naschek initiated coverage of Charter One Financial Inc and Washington Mutual Savings Bank with a buy rating and H.F. Ahmanson & Co, Dime Bancorp Inc and Great Western Financial Corp with hold rating.

-- Salomon said in a research note that Charter One and Washington Mutual were rated buy "based on their compelling fundamental outlooks, which suggest that their premium valuations over other thrifts are not only warranted but probably conservatively stated."
-- Naschek assigned both stocks a $50 price target, or approximately 20 percent upside over the next 12 months.
-- He said that H.F. Ahmanson and Great Western shares were already discounting the optimistic fundamental outlook while Dime Corp's share price has soared in the past few months.

-- In early afternoon trading, Charter One was up one at 43; Washington Mutual was up 3/8 at 43-1/4; H.F. Ahmanson was down 3/8 at 30-5/8; Dime was down 1/8 at 15-1/4 and Great Western fell 5/8 to 27-5/8.
